title: Man in Phone Frame
description: A man with a beard and dark hoodie stands centered looking forward with a serious expression. His hands are in the pockets of his hoodie. The setting is inside a large painted smartphone frame with a colorful border against a dark background.
prompt: A realistic oil painting shows a bearded man in a dark hoodie standing straight and looking directly forward with a serious face. His hands are inside the hoodie pockets. He is framed inside a large black smartphone shape that has a colorful painted border in yellow red and green with paint drips. The background inside the phone is dark teal and the outer background is very dark.
